options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: host
options.description: The remote IP address or hostname of the authentication server.

options.name: ldap_allow_unauthenticated
options.description: Enables or disables unauthenticated binding. Unauthenticated binds are bind with an existing login but with an empty password. Some LDAP servers (Microsoft AD) allow this type of bind without any possibility to disable it.

options.name: ldap_attr_group
options.description: The LDAP group attribute.

options.name: ldap_attr_groupobj
options.description: The group object class for groups in RFC2307 mode.

options.name: ldap_attr_member
options.description: The LDAP member attribute.

options.name: ldap_attr_user
options.description: The LDAP user attribute.

options.name: ldap_authcn
options.description: The LDAP authentication container.

options.name: ldap_basedn
options.description: The root for LDAP searches on this authentication server.

options.name: ldap_binddn
options.description: The DN to use when binding to this authentication server. Set to `null` to bind anonymously.

options.name: ldap_bindpw
options.description: The password to use when binding to this authentication server.

options.name: ldap_caref
options.description: The certificate authority used to validate the LDAP server certificate.

options.name: ldap_extended_enabled
options.description: Enable LDAP extended queries.

options.name: ldap_extended_query
options.description: The extended LDAP query to make during LDAP searches.

options.name: ldap_nostrip_at
options.description: Do not strip away parts of the username after the @ symbol.

options.name: ldap_pam_groupdn
options.description: The group DN to use for shell authentication. Users must be a member of this group and have valid posixAccount attributes to sign in.

options.name: ldap_port
options.description: The LDAP port to connect to on this LDAP authentication server. Valid options are: a TCP/UDP port number

options.name: ldap_protver
options.description: The LDAP protocol version to use for connections to this LDAP authentication server.

options.name: ldap_rfc2307
options.description: Enables or disable RFC2307 LDAP options.

options.name: ldap_rfc2307_userdn
options.description: Enables or disable the use of DNs for username searches.

options.name: ldap_scope
options.description: The LDAP search scope. Use `one` to limit the scope to a single level, or `subtree` to allow the entire subtree to be searched.

options.name: ldap_timeout
options.description: The timeout (in seconds) for connections to the LDAP authentication server.

options.name: ldap_urltype
options.description: The encryption mode to use when connecting to this authentication server. Use `Standard TCP` for unencrypted LDAP connections, use `STARTTLS Encrypt` to start an encrypted connection via STARTTLS if it's available, or `SSL/TLS Encrypted` to only use LDAPS encrypted connections.

options.name: ldap_utf8
options.description: Enables or disables UTF-8 encoding LDAP parameters before sending them to this authentication server

options.name: lookup_fields
options.description: The list of fields to use when looking up existing resources. This should be a list of field names that uniquely identify a resource.

options.name: name
options.description: The descriptive name for this authentication server.

options.name: radius_acct_port
options.description: The port used by RADIUS for accounting. Set to `null` to disable use of accounting services. Valid options are: a TCP/UDP port number

options.name: radius_auth_port
options.description: The port used by RADIUS for authentication. Set to `null` to disable use of authentication services. Valid options are: a TCP/UDP port number

options.name: radius_nasip_attribute
options.description: The interface whose IP will be used as the 'NAS-IP-Address' attribute during RADIUS Access-Requests. This choice will not change the interface used for contacting the RADIUS server.

options.name: radius_protocol
options.description: The RADIUS protocol to use when authenticating.

options.name: radius_secret
options.description: The shared secret to use when authenticating to this RADIUS server.

options.name: radius_timeout
options.description: The timeout (in seconds) for connections to this RADIUS authentication server.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should be present or absent.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of this authentication server.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.
